source.title: Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Local Council Elections: No Contests for County Council")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name and label read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1958: nominations taken by H. W. F. Reid, returning officer, on Tuesday 20 May 1958; every seat returned unopposed (18 Unionists and 4 Nationalists: Newry Telegraph, 24 May 1958, p. 8), so there was no poll on 5 June 1958. All the retiring members were renominated except in Breagh and Tandragee. Returned unopposed.
